meta.name: refactoring-dbt-models
meta.description:
Safely refactors dbt models with downstream impact analysis. Use when restructuring dbt models for:
(1) Task mentions "refactor", "restructure", "extract", "split", "break into", or "reorganize"
(2) Extracting CTEs to intermediate models or creating macros
(3) Modifying model logic that has downstream consumers
(4) Renaming columns, changing types, or reorganizing model dependencies
Analyzes all downstream dependencies BEFORE making changes.

copy.tagline_en: Safely refactor dbt models with downstream impact analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are restructuring dbt models and need to avoid breaking downstream dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你安全地重构 dbt 模型。它会先分析所有下游依赖，然后一步步提取长 CTE、创建宏、拆分复杂逻辑，并验证输出是否一致。
howto.when: 当你提到“重构”、“拆分”、“提取”等关键词，或者要求修改有下游消费者使用的模型逻辑时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构 orders.sql，把超过50行的 CTE 提取成中间模型。
say.note: Claude 会分析依赖并执行提取。

say.text: 把重复的金额分类逻辑做成宏。
say.note: Claude 会创建宏并更新模型引用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you safely refactor dbt models. It first analyzes all downstream dependencies, then extracts long CTEs, creates macros, splits complex logic, and verifies output consistency step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "refactor", "split", "extract", or when modifying model logic that has downstream consumers.

say_en.text: Refactor orders.sql by extracting CTEs longer than 50 lines into intermediate models.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze dependencies and perform extraction.

say_en.text: Create a macro for the repeated amount categorization logic.
say_en.note: Claude will create the macro and update model references.
